request.prompt:
Korean webtoon panel, digitally inked and coloured by a professional webtoon studio. Crisp black ink with tapered strokes, heavier on the outer silhouette, the jaw, the hair mass and where forms overlap. Flat local colour with one hard-edged cool cel shadow per material. One named key light: its colour washes smoothly over the lit side. If the scene names a back light, it draws a thin crisp rim along the figure's silhouette. Everything else stays flat. Muted cool base palette of slate, navy and grey-blue, so the light source and the character's signature colour carry the saturation. Background simplified and lower in contrast than the characters. Small crisp highlights; glossy specular only on metal and wet surfaces.

Hand-made webtoon colouring: each garment has only a few large, opaque, clean-edged shadow shapes, placed in its real folds; no scattered translucent streaks, zigzag shards or crumpled-foil folds. Worn cloth shows a few small frayed notches and loose threads, never sawtooth edges along every edge. Plain shoes and clothes with no logos, stripes or brand marks. Every strap, buckle, pocket and seam is attached and has a purpose; no stray stitch marks. Matte skin, hair and stone; no 3D, low-poly or plastic look.

reaction: square inset, close-up. Front-side light on the face; a flat or gradient background in the mood colour. Small calm corner on the LEFT.

Camera: close, Jaeha touching his upper lip
Light: cyan from below; red from above
Scene: Jaeha (kang_jaeha, vest), on one knee behind the pillar, touches his upper lip with two gloved fingers. A thin line of blood runs from his nose; the fingertips come away red. He blinks at them.

One square PNG at native 1254×1254 or 1024×1024. Camera 0.95 m above the floor, close to the kneeling man's face height, looking slightly down at his tipped head and lifted right fingertips, slight three-quarter view showing his RIGHT ear and pencil at picture-left. The horizon is near the lower face; no standing figures. Jaeha is 178 cm standing, 7.5–8 heads in full-body proportions, normal-length neck and torso; crop at the chest/frame edge instead of compressing him. His right hand is closer than his face, palm toward himself; exactly the right index and middle fingertips carry small fresh red smears, other fingers relaxed and partly curled. His left hand is below the crop bracing on his raised knee. Keep most of the left quarter lower-contrast and calm for lettering. One thin nosebleed; mouth slightly open mid-line, surprised polite public face. Cyan under-light from the existing husk fragments OFF-PANEL below and a thin red rim from the knight OFF-PANEL above; no new source, no window or floating effect. A cropped familiar square stone pillar edge behind his near shoulder establishes cover. The knight, Nib and Yerin stay outside this close crop. Full model-sheet proportions, no compressed bodies; crop at the frame edge instead.

Acting:
kang_jaeha: on one knee, head tipped down a little, two fingers of his right hand lifted away from under his nose so he can look at them; eyes wide, brows up, mouth slightly open; a thin trickle of blood from one nostril
Eyeline: Jaeha → his own fingertips

The reference images show only the characters' design (face, hair, clothes, colours, props). Do not copy their standing poses or front-facing angles: pose, camera and expression come only from the scene text.

The attached last image is an approved acting-style anchor: match its crisp ink, restrained cel rendering, facial acting and clothing shadow simplicity, not its pose, cast or lighting. Location geometry comes from the boss-room key; character identity from the approved sheets.

No text, letters, numbers, speech bubbles, captions, sound-effect lettering, interface windows or readable signs. Emblems without letters are fine; no brand logos or wordmarks. Not a 3D render, not a photograph, no photographic background. No airbrushed skin, no plastic gloss on skin or hair, no haze or bloom over the whole image, no depth-of-field blur, no lens flare unless a real camera flash is in the scene. No watermark or signature. Correct hands with five fingers. No chibi proportions unless the brief says chibi. No compressed or stubby bodies, no shortened legs or torsos, no oversized heads; no people out of scale with the doors, vehicles and buildings around them; no figures floating off the floor or breaking the scene's perspective.

Korean webtoon panel, digitally inked and coloured by a professional webtoon studio. Crisp black ink with tapered strokes, heavier on the outer silhouette, the jaw, the hair mass and where forms overlap. Flat local colour with one hard-edged cool cel shadow per material. One named key light: its colour washes smoothly over the lit side. If the scene names a back light, it draws a thin crisp rim along the figure's silhouette. Everything else stays flat. Muted cool base palette of slate, navy and grey-blue, so the light source and the character's signature colour carry the saturation. Background simplified and lower in contrast than the characters. Small crisp highlights; glossy specular only on metal and wet surfaces.

Hand-made webtoon colouring: each garment has only a few large, opaque, clean-edged shadow shapes, placed in its real folds; no scattered translucent streaks, zigzag shards or crumpled-foil folds. Worn cloth shows a few small frayed notches and loose threads, never sawtooth edges along every edge. Plain shoes and clothes with no logos, stripes or brand marks. Every strap, buckle, pocket and seam is attached and has a purpose; no stray stitch marks. Matte skin, hair and stone; no 3D, low-poly or plastic look.

name-card: tall portrait, knees-up, three-quarter view, slight low angle. Key light from the side the character faces; a back light draws the rim on the other edge; a gradient background in the card colours. One clear side, the RIGHT third, for the later name card.

Camera: knees up, three-quarter, slight low angle: Nib at the pillar's edge
Light: key: green-dusk light from the left; back light: red from the knight beyond the pillar, rimming his ears and scarf
Scene: Nib (nib, mask) stands at the edge of the pillar, peering round it toward the knight, knives in reverse grip. Long ears swept back (the LEFT one notched), the long red scarf, the belted sleeveless cloak with too many pockets, brass binoculars on his chest, bare feet. The cracked white husk mask covers the upper left of his face; his uncovered right eye glows faintly amber. Name-card gradient behind him, dark umber to amber. Leave the right third calm.

One portrait PNG exactly 1024×1536. Camera at 0.65 m above the floor, angled up only slightly toward Nib's 105 cm adult veteran body, about six small heads tall with long limbs. Horizon near his waist. Crop below knees as prescribed by knees-up camera; keep thighs and torso full length. Nib occupies the left two thirds, pressed to the SAME square pillar edge that divides cover from knight's side to picture-left; his head turns LEFT, peering round stone to the hostile knight entirely OFF-PANEL LEFT. Both knives drawn and held in reverse grip, right one flat against stone, no knives duplicated in back sheaths. His upper LEFT face and LEFT eye are covered by the cracked featureless porcelain mask. His uncovered RIGHT eye glows faint amber; no outline, aura or LINK yet (LINK begins P27). Keep the LEFT ear notch and a single lower LEFT fang correctly placed, only where visible. Cloak is SEAL 1/5 charcoal, no wall-blue lining, bronze edging, bronze armour or nine-tower clasp. Hood DOWN, plain iron clasp, muted crimson scarf, brass binoculars attached at chest. The RIGHT third is a continuous quiet dark-umber-to-amber non-glowing gradient, no card shape, type, border or lettering. Green-dusk key from picture-left and thin red rim from the off-panel knight on ears/scarf; amber remains only his eye. Full model-sheet proportions, no compressed bodies; crop at the frame edge instead.

Acting:
nib: pressed side-on to the pillar's edge in a scout's stoop, peering round it; both knives in reverse grip, the right one held flat against the stone; weight on the balls of his bare feet; face deadpan
Eyeline: Nib → the knight (off-panel left, round the pillar)

The reference images show only the characters' design (face, hair, clothes, colours, props). Do not copy their standing poses or front-facing angles: pose, camera and expression come only from the scene text.

Nib: an adult goblin scout and veteran soldier, 105 cm, wiry and long-limbed with long bony hands; grey-green skin; a narrow angular head with a heavy brow ridge, hollow cheeks and a narrow pointed chin, long pointed ears swept back with a V-notch near the tip of the LEFT ear; a long pointed nose with a slight hook that sticks out clearly in profile; a thin, wide mouth with one small lower fang on the left; amber-yellow eyes with heavy lined lower lids; shaggy black hair; a knee-length charcoal hooded cloak (hood down), belted at the waist, sleeveless with wide armholes, small pockets sewn onto it and a frayed, scorched hem; a long red scarf wrapped twice round his neck, compact brass binoculars on a strap at his chest, two short knives in crossed sheaths at the small of his back, bare feet. Deadpan, never cute.
The cracked white upper-left piece of a featureless doll face covers his left eye like a broken mask.

The attached last image is an approved acting-style anchor: match its crisp ink, restrained cel rendering, facial acting and clothing shadow simplicity, not its pose, cast or lighting. Location geometry comes from the boss-room key; character identity from the approved sheets.

No text, letters, numbers, speech bubbles, captions, sound-effect lettering, interface windows or readable signs. Emblems without letters are fine; no brand logos or wordmarks. Not a 3D render, not a photograph, no photographic background. No airbrushed skin, no plastic gloss on skin or hair, no haze or bloom over the whole image, no depth-of-field blur, no lens flare unless a real camera flash is in the scene. No watermark or signature. Correct hands with five fingers. No chibi proportions unless the brief says chibi. No compressed or stubby bodies, no shortened legs or torsos, no oversized heads; no people out of scale with the doors, vehicles and buildings around them; no figures floating off the floor or breaking the scene's perspective.

problems: 11c.9: speaking mouth closed; 11b.2: hem has too many shredded points and holes; camera crops lower legs rather than knees-up.

Never a sealed line mouth. Frame KNEES-UP: cut the body at the knees along the bottom edge, no calves or feet anywhere. At this crop he should fill about 4–4.5 head lengths from crown to frame bottom while preserving his complete six-head anatomical proportions beyond the crop. Beyond the pillar use ONLY the umber-to-amber gradient, no blurred masonry or arches. No depth-of-field blur anywhere. His right knife lies parallel and close to the pillar face in reverse grip. Both hands hold one knife each, all sheaths empty.

reused_images.provenance_note: Existing survivor preserved unchanged per explicit keep instruction. Original generation request unavailable in art branch; not reconstructed or invented. This is not a new approval.

source_panel_fields.camera: low and wide from the floor beside Yerin: the giant blade held up by the small goblin, the knight towering behind, the pillar at picture-right
source_panel_fields.light: key: faint cyan glow from the husk's broken shards on the floor, under-lighting Nib; back light: the knight's red face-hole high above, a red rim along the blade
source_panel_fields.art: The exact moment chapter 1 ended. The knight's (knight_commander) huge sword presses down on Nib (nib, mask), who holds it off with one short knife, the blade's spine against his left forearm, his other knife loose in a reverse grip. White husk shards with a faint cyan glow lie scattered round his bare feet. Yerin (song_yerin) is on the floor behind him. Nib looks back over his shoulder toward the pillar at picture-right, where Jaeha is (off-panel). Sparks where steel grinds on steel. Scale: the knight is 4.5 m tall standing, so bent over the sword he still towers; Nib (105 cm, a lanky 6 heads) reaches no higher than the knight's shin.

acting.nib: braced under the blade with his weight low, the blade's spine on his left forearm and that knife holding it off; the right knife loose in a reverse grip at his hip; head turned back over his shoulder toward the pillar, unhurried, eyelids half-lowered, mouth a flat line moving on the line
acting.song_yerin: on the floor behind him, propped on her elbows, staring up at the blade

source_panel_fields.eyeline: Nib → Jaeha (off-panel right); Yerin → the blade

lines.text: YOU'RE IN CHARGE? THEN WHY ARE YOU THE ONE BLEEDING?

blocked.reason: At least six mandatory local PNG paths for the three readable heroes: their fronts (3), Nib mask turnaround (1), boss-room key (1), approved acting-style anchor (1). Backend cap is five. This minimum already omits the additional turnaround/face sheets named by HANDOFF section 1. No missing-reference call, collage, transformed original or brief-only drawing attempted.

The Nib front + mask turnaround + face sheet set required by HANDOFF section 1 and Chapter 2, plus the approved distinctive sword detail, location key, and required acting-style anchor needs six paths. P03 is the sword-contact close action; omitting its approved weapon reference or mandatory face reference would silently choose a relaxation. Panel brief section 2 prioritizes fronts/location and makes extra acting sheets conditional, while the handoff names the face/turnaround set. Held for an explicit reference-priority resolution rather than omitting a critical reference.

first_saved_checkpoint.outcome: saved and reported before continuing; then archived for depth blur
